productPageReviews.reviewTitle: Refurbished phone that doesn’t work, shuts down with battery fully chargedRefurbished phone that doesn’t work, shuts down with battery fully charged
productPageReviews.reviewDescription: AVOID THIS SELLER. TAKE MY WORD FOR IT SAVE YOURSELF ALL A LOT OF TROUBLE. Seller sold me a defective phone that can’t be used because it powers itself off with a full battery 5 min into a telephone call or searching something on the internet- it powers down literally every 5 min or so- you have to power it back on for it to shut itself back down again the cycle just continues. The phone arrived no scratches looked brand new. Plugged phone in let it charge enough to take into AT&T to have cellular service put on the IPhone 11. The phone was first powered on inside the At&T store. I immediately noticed blacked out places at the bottom of the screen and a black line towards the bottom of the screen (see pictures) once At&T service connected with a fully charged battery the phone shuts down and cuts off 5 min after turned on-it just cuts off, you turn it back on, it may stay on for 10 min, it turns itself off or just shuts down again. This cycle of shutting off powering down continues over and over: Quality of the item in sellers description states refurbished phone fully working condition, I was thinking the phone may arrive a few scratches, but the internal hardware works properly when it was the exact opposite. I would avoid this seller just because to return the item due to the lithium batteries in cellular phones, you can’t drop it off at a UPS STORE, you must box the item up, print out the shipping label, then wait at your home all day on a scheduled pick up day for Fed Ex to pick your phone up. I scheduled a pick up day with Amazon and Fed Ex never came. Fed Ex has to pick up lithium batteries, UPS I assume doesn’t ship cellular phones, the representative with Amazon said Fed Ex- I am not sure why about that part, but I waited at my home all day and a driver never showed up to pick up the item. They schedule the day not the time. A wasted day for me on top of the hassle of everything that comes with putting service on the phone then deleting everything off the phone to return it- defective item and too much hassle to return. Not worth the trouble. I am pretty laid back, this experience has made me a bit aggravated. I feel the seller my should check the phones before selling them- if they checked this phone they clearly would have seen the blacked out splotches on the bottom corner of the screen where you can’t see any screen only black and the black line- that would probably be a good indication the phone has internal issues it needs further investigation to fix before selling or just don’t sell the iphone. Dear seller, please do not do this to others in the future- just do not ship a phone out in that condition. This seller would receive 0 stars from me if that were an option. Seriously, avoid this seller- save yourself the hassle. I was nice added no scratches and put a picture of the back of the phone to show no scratches- the iPhone just doesn’t work. - one aggravated customer.

productPageReviews.reviewTitle: Awesome Phone But Missing A Few Features I Wish It Had
productPageReviews.reviewDescription: Love the phone especially because it is a flip phone. Great screen size, look and feel.The reason I wanted a flip phone is because I constantly break/crack the screen on the standard phones. It does not matter if I buy the most expensive bulletproof phone case. Those cases only protect the phone/screen if the phone falls on an edge or back side. If the phone lands on an object anywhere on the screen, they automatically crack the screen. Not with a flip phone. Once closed, the screen is protected and if you buy a case for it like I did, now it's truly bulletproof. I've accidentally dropped my phone so many times and no damage to the screen at all. My phone case also protects the small outside screen.I actually like this version with the small screen in the front. Makes it harder to damage it. The larger the screen, the bigger the chances of damaging it like the standard phones.When flipped closed, takes up way less space in my pants pockets compared to a non flip phone. No chance of it slipping out my pocket. The phone case I added does make it bulkier but if you're not using one or a really thin skin type cover, pretty thin sleek phone.The only negatives I really have are:It does not have an external SD card slot for memory. Whatever memory the phone comes with, that's it. This also makes it harder to track, save, and transfer files like pics and videos.It does have wireless charging (I wouldn't have bought it if it didn't) however, it is slow. I believe the wireless charging is rated at 5W max. Wired charging is fast though (30W max). I just prefer wireless charging because all charging ports (on all phones) do wear out over time and eventually fail preventing from charging the phone.The crease in the middle of the screen starts becoming noticeable on the screen after so much use, abuse, and flips. This doesn't bother me and I don't really notice it when watching videos but others are super sensitive to this and want perfect screen clarity always, so keep that in mind. This tradeoff for having a flip phone is worth it to me. This flip phone screen technology is still new so I expect the screens to only get better in the future.Overall, love my phone and don't regret this purchase.
productPageReviews.reviewedIn: Reviewed in the United States on December 27, 2025

productPageReviews.reviewTitle: Why do phones have to be so HUGE?
productPageReviews.reviewDescription: As far as this being as-advertised, it is.  As far as being renewed, it appears to be brand new.  It does have the AT&T OS and bloatware installed.  I popped in my SIM card, and it immediately started working with my PureTalk account.  The phone works great with no issues.  Battery life is, to my mind, a weak point.  It lasts me all day, but won't go two, and I am not a heavy user or game-player.  I don't watch a lot of video.  As for the phone design, I am not a big fan.  When open, it is very long and thin, which makes it very difficult to hang onto.  When folded, it is pretty chunky.  I added a thin case to make it easier to grip, and with the case, it is 13/16" thick when folded - this pushes the limits of "pocket-sized", which is the only reason to purchase a Razr in the first place.  The small outside screen on the 2023 model is a cool feature, but isn't very touch-responsive.  I often have trouble getting it to answer a call or turn off an alarm.  This is unfortunate, because the alternative is to un-fold the phone to get to the main screen, and there is a very finite number of unfolds before the screen will crack.  I have only taken a few photos, but the quality and lighting seems to be pretty decent, but not quite as good as my wife's Pixel4.  So, bottom line, I bought this phone for the single reason that it folds up "small".  I want it to fit easily in my pocket.  This is marginal on that goal, but it is better than any other phone non-folding on the US market.  Why on earth do phones have to ALL be so large?  Please, Samsung or somebody, offer us at least ONE decent 5" Android phone for the US market!
productPageReviews.reviewedIn: Reviewed in the United States on June 30, 2026

Same night I was refunded for the accessories but not the phone.... to this day almost 2 weeks later I still have not received my refund of the phone yet? Any store with the product and a receipt would refund your money instantly, but amazon takes weeks apparently and even possibly a month.  I have literally spent thousands on their shopping site, I pay my prime membership, I even bought add on subscriptions through them like unlimited music, audible, apple TV, paramount plus, food delivery.  Do you think they care.. nope I'm so disappointed that 2 weeks later I'm still waiting on over $200 when they very clearly can see they received the product on the tracking return sheet Kohls provides for verification for both parties. productPageReviews.reviewDescription: I’ve been using this Mobile Pixels monitor setup for a bit now, and it’s honestly been a huge productivity boost. When I’m traveling or working somewhere I don’t have space for multiple monitors, this thing is a game-changer.The color and build quality are excellent — it feels solid, not flimsy — and the hinges hold their position really well when the screens are extended. I’ve owned several Mobile Pixels products before, and this is easily my favorite so far. It just feels more refined and sturdy.Being able to have multiple screens open at once instead of constantly switching tabs has easily made me twice as efficient (if not more) during the day. Setup is simple, it packs down nicely, and it’s perfect for anyone who needs a flexible, portable multi-monitor setup.Highly recommend if you want a serious workflow upgrade without a permanent desk setup.

productPageReviews.reviewTitle: Things To Keep In Mind Before Buying... But Still Worth It!
productPageReviews.reviewDescription: It's currently 10/6 that I'm making this review and this product was delivered to me on 10/2. Here's what I have to say.This is a GREAT second monitor to have. The speed and quality to me are great and I definitely feel I can work twice as fast with it. I did run into an issue with magnets (the first time). I didn't know how to position them properly and ended up destroying the first set. However, the second time was a lot better so I still have one spare set left and the monitor fits well on my laptop now.When I placed the second magnets on my laptop, I put some heavy items ontop of my laptop for at least 1 hr to make sure the magnets stuck and it has worked ever since. This isn't the type of monitor you can just pick up with your laptop and walk around the house with (Unless you have it in the case on the back of your pc but it may swing your monitor back to far if you're not careful), but it is good if you're sitting in a chair and recliner. I have a flimsy laptop screen but it doesn't effect it at all. It fits into my backpack just fine and the two cords we have are helpful for plugging things up.I combined this monitor with 3 items of purchase, my gaming laptop, a portable cooling fan, and a lap desk tray with a retractable mousepad. It's a wonderful work station though can be a bit heavy to carry in your backpack unless those are the only things you carry.Ultimately this is a 4 star because of the trouble with magnets, it's tricky to sheath my second minor unless the laptop is closed, and it came with a small scratch but nothing worth worry about. Still a purchase worth buying instead of a completely separate monitor that hogs up space on a table.

productPageReviews.reviewDescription: This is a genuinely useful “portable workstation” upgrade, because it combines two additional monitors into one integrated, laptop-mounted system instead of making you juggle separate portable screens, stands, and cables. The build feels more premium than most generic extenders: the screens slide out smoothly, the structure feels stable once positioned, and it’s designed to travel as a single, compact unit.In real use, the biggest win is workflow speed: you can keep email/Teams on one side, a live spreadsheet or CRM on the other, and your main work centered so you’re not constantly alt tabbing or losing context.A key setup note: scan the QR code in the box, it takes you directly to installation support and the correct download path. You’ll also need to install the driver for full functionality; that step is critical because without it, both external monitors won’t run properly together (you may see only one screen working or inconsistent behavior). After the driver is installed, everything becomes much more “set it and forget it,” and the dual monitors extend reliably like standard external displays.What makes it stand out versus most portable monitors is the integration and versatility: you get a true triple display layout that stays aligned with your laptop (instead of two loose panels on a café table), and it’s built for real world movement, hotel desks, client sites, airport lounges. It also supports flexible working styles: side-by-side multitasking, sharing one screen with a colleague while keeping your primary work private, and quick reorientation depending on how you like to manage reference documents or dashboards. The end result is a cleaner, more professional multi-screen setup that feels closer to a desktop experience, while still being something you can pack up and move in minutes.

productPageReviewsFromOtherCountries.reviewTitle: Momcozy Mobile Flow M9 Milchpumpe – Effizienz und Komfort in einem
productPageReviewsFromOtherCountries.reviewDescription: Für frischgebackene Mütter, die den Spagat zwischen Abpumpen und Alltagsaufgaben bewältigen müssen, ist die Momcozy Mobile Flow M9 Milchpumpe eine innovative und durchdachte Lösung. Mit ihrem freihändigen Design und der App-Steuerung bietet sie Komfort und Flexibilität auf einem hohen Niveau.Umfangreiche Einstellmöglichkeiten für ein individuelles AbpumpenDie M9 Milchpumpe kommt mit 15 verschiedenen Saugstufen, die in Kombination mit drei Modi (Stimulation, Abpumpen und Gemischt) maximale Individualisierung ermöglichen. Das bedeutet, dass jede Mutter den für sich angenehmsten Rhythmus und Saugdruck finden kann. Besonders praktisch ist die „Momcozy“-App, mit der die Pumpe einfach gesteuert werden kann. So lässt sich das Pumpen starten, stoppen, anpassen oder eine Countdown-Zeit einstellen, ohne dass man die Pumpe direkt bedienen muss. Das erlaubt eine nahtlose Anpassung an den eigenen Körper und die jeweilige Situation, was den Komfort erheblich steigert.Freihändiges Design – Flexibilität im AlltagEin echtes Highlight der Momcozy M9 ist das durchdachte, tropfenförmige Design, das sich nahtlos in den BH einfügen lässt. Die Pumpe ist diskret und erlaubt es, in völliger Privatsphäre abzupumpen, ohne dass man an einen Ort gebunden ist oder spezielle Kleidung tragen muss. Durch das freihändige Design sind die Hände während des Pumpens frei, sodass man gleichzeitig anderen Tätigkeiten nachgehen kann. Ob beim Arbeiten am Laptop, Kochen oder einfachen Haushaltsaufgaben – die Momcozy Pumpe ist so leicht und unauffällig, dass sie den Alltag kaum beeinträchtigt.Komfortable und sichere AnwendungBesonders überzeugt hat mich die Kombination aus weichem und hartem Silikon bei den DoubleFit Flanges, die in vier verschiedenen Größen (17, 19, 21 und 24 mm) verfügbar sind. Dadurch kann die Pumpe an jede Brustgröße angepasst werden, was den Komfort und die Effizienz des Abpumpens erheblich steigert. Das Material fühlt sich angenehm an und sorgt für ein sicheres Gefühl bei der Anwendung. Zudem ist die Pumpe leicht zu reinigen, was den täglichen Gebrauch erleichtert.Leistungsstark und dennoch leiseTrotz ihrer starken Leistung bleibt die M9 Milchpumpe angenehm leise, was sie ideal für diskretes Abpumpen im Büro oder in ruhigen Umgebungen macht. Laut Hersteller arbeitet die Pumpe mit nur 35 dB, was tatsächlich kaum als störend wahrgenommen wird. Selbst bei höheren Saugstufen bleibt die Geräuschentwicklung minimal. Das ermöglicht es, zu jeder Tages- und Nachtzeit zu pumpen, ohne dabei den Partner oder das Baby zu stören.Praktische MuttermilchaufbewahrungEin weiteres nützliches Feature ist der mitgelieferte stapelbare Milchsammler, der aus Tritan gefertigt ist. Dieses Material ist nicht nur langlebig und bruchsicher, sondern auch BPA-frei und umweltfreundlich. Es sorgt dafür, dass die abgepumpte Milch sicher aufbewahrt werden kann, und die Behälter sind leicht in den Kühlschrank oder die Tiefkühltruhe zu verstauen. Für mich war es sehr praktisch, dass man die Milchbehälter unabhängig voneinander nutzen und stapeln kann, was Platz spart und die Handhabung erleichtert.Preis-Leistungs-VerhältnisDer Preis von 316,99 € mag auf den ersten Blick hoch erscheinen, aber die gebotene Leistung rechtfertigt den Betrag. Die hochwertige Verarbeitung, die durchdachten Funktionen und die Flexibilität der Pumpe machen sie zu einer lohnenden Investition für Mütter, die häufig abpumpen müssen und Wert auf Komfort legen. Auch wenn es günstigere Modelle gibt, bietet die Momcozy M9 durch ihre vielen Funktionen und das komfortable Design einen echten Mehrwert.FazitFür Mütter, die eine hochwertige, leistungsstarke und komfortable Milchpumpe suchen, ist die Momcozy Mobile Flow M9 eine hervorragende Wahl. Sie überzeugt durch ihre zahlreichen Einstellmöglichkeiten, die einfache Handhabung über die App und das diskrete Design. Das freihändige Abpumpen erleichtert den Alltag enorm, da man gleichzeitig anderen Aufgaben nachgehen kann, ohne das Pumpen zu vernachlässigen. Trotz des höheren Preises bietet die M9 ein starkes Gesamtpaket, das durch die Kombination aus Komfort, Effizienz und Benutzerfreundlichkeit vollends überzeugt. Ich kann die Pumpe daher wärmstens empfehlen, vor allem für Mütter, die Flexibilität und Komfort schätzen und regelmäßig abpumpen müssen.

Das Design der Momcozy Milchpumpe ist innovativ und auf eine coole und interessante Art anders.Die Milchpumpe ist klein, leise, kabellos und mit App steuerbar.Es lassen sich ein oder zwei Pumpeinheiten erwerben ich empfehle ganz klar diese gleich alsDoppelmilchpumpe zu nutzen, auch wenn der Preis zu einer einen enormen Preisunterschied macht.Der Auffangbehälter besteht aus BPA-freiem Kunststoff und kann zum Einfrieren der Muttermilch genutzt werden.Die Milchpumpe ist mit ein wiederaufladbaren Lithiumbatterie ausgestattet die im Dauerbetrieb ca. 2 Stunden lang hält. Bei 20 minütigen Pumpzyklen kann also ca. sechsmal abgepumpt werden.Der Zusammenbau der Pumpe ist quasi selbsterklärend und ist mit ein paar Handgriffen erledigt.Mit der App und Bluetooth-Verbindung lässt sich die Milchmenge, Dauer und Häufigkeit der Pumpvorgänge nachvollziehen und natürlich auch fernsteuern.Die Pumpstärke ist über sieben Stufen regulierbar.Diese lassen sich praktisch im BH stecken und sind nahezu unsichtbar, bei Frauen mit eher größeren Brüsten funktioniert es generell auch, ist aber schon was auffälliger.Das schöne die Momcozy-Milchpumpe arbeitet sehr diskret also leise und kann somit auch super auf der Arbeit verwendet werden.Insgesamt bin ich der Meinung, das die Momcozy Milchpumpen vor allem fürs Stillen im Beruf momentan die beste Lösung ist.⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐

Conosco già il marchio Momcozy e una delle cose che apprezzo di più è l'impegno nel trovare soluzioni davvero efficaci per aiutare i genitori a gestire al meglio i primi mesi con il bambino. Sono molto attenti a creare prodotti che semplificano la vita, riducendo lo stress legato a strumenti che non funzionano come dovrebbero. Il nome "Momcozy" riflette perfettamente questa filosofia: rendere le mamme più serene attraverso la praticità dei loro prodotti.Uno dei principali problemi con i tiralatte è che spesso richiedono l'uso costante di almeno una mano, perché sono troppo ingombranti o semplicemente non pensati per rimanere in posizione da soli, o ancora, perché sono manuali e non automatici. Questo modello, il Mobile Flow, risolve proprio questo inconveniente.Il set include:- 2 tiralatte portatili completi di tutti i componenti che li costituiscono (taglia 24mm)- Inserti per capezzoli taglia 17/19/21 mm- 2 cavi USB per la ricarica- Il manuale d'istruzioni + una Guida rapida per iniziare- 1 cartoncino per misurare la taglia del capezzolo- 1 astuccio per riporre il tutto quando non in usoLa flangia fornita è da 24 mm, ma grazie al cartoncino incluso per la misurazione del capezzolo, è possibile verificare la propria misura e utilizzare l’inserto corretto. Questo dettaglio è davvero utile perché permette di personalizzare il tiralatte in base alle proprie esigenze, migliorando comfort e funzionalità. Non si è costretti a "sopportare" una misura universale, il che riduce molto lo stress.I comandi e il display sono posizionati sulla parte superiore, rendendo facile e immediato leggere tutte le informazioni mentre lo si indossa. Mi piace molto la possibilità di scegliere tra tanti livelli di stimolazione e intensità, così da poter adattare l'utilizzo alle proprie necessità e al proprio corpo. Puoi personalizzare ogni sessione, e addirittura differenziare i programmi tra un seno e l’altro, considerando che spesso le esigenze sono diverse tra i due seni.Altra comodità è il poter associare i tiralatte all’app di Momcozy dove poter controllare tutte le impostazioni da remoto e verificare anche i dosaggi di latte estratti, tenendo memoria delle varie poppate. Utilissima. L’associazione dei tiralatte e l’utilizzo dell’app è facile e intuitiva.Il tiralatte si carica tramite cavo USB-C, e come molti altri dispositivi moderni, non è incluso il trasformatore. Con una singola ricarica si riescono a coprire circa 3 ore di utilizzo (dipende anche dalle intensità impostate), che permettono diverse sessioni a seconda delle necessità personali, sicuramente abbastanza per gestire buona parte delle poppate durante la giornata.Tra i vari tiralatte che ho provato, questo è sicuramente uno dei più discreti sia in termini di dimensioni che di rumorosità; anche se comunque non è del tutto silenzioso, quindi se siete in pubblico sappiate che si potrebbe comunque notare. Inoltre, non è completamente invisibile sotto una maglietta attillata, ma con un abbigliamento più morbido è tranquillamente indossabile anche fuori casa. Consiglio di tenerlo in posizione con le mani per i primi minuti finché non aderisce bene, ma una volta sistemato è perfetto per svolgere attività leggere come leggere un libro, lavorare al computer o persino cambiare il pannolino.In conclusione, si tratta di un prodotto di altissima qualità che consiglio vivamente a chi cerca un tiralatte efficiente e comodo.Consiglio vivamente.

aPlusContent.title: Product description
aPlusContent.rawText:
Product description
Montessori Mobile Designed for Baby’s Eye View 
No more boring bottoms! Your baby can now see the full patterns of crib toys hanging, keeping them engaged and visually stimulated. 
Montessori-Inspired for Holistic Development 
Designed to support early development with high contrast - black and white patterns that capture your baby’s attention and stimulate their senses. 
Did You Know? Babies Only See High-Contrast Colors 
They Ignore The Colorful Crib Mobile You Bought! 
That’s why they don’t enjoy bright, low-contrast colors – their vision isn’t fully developed yet. 
Babies Prefer High-Contrast Colors 
High-contrast designs are proven to attract babies more, which is why they love Tinitigies mobiles so much! 
The TINITIGIES music box features 12 soothing lullabies 

The TINITIGIES music box features 12 soothing lullabies, including classics like Twinkle Twinkle Little Star, Brahms’ Lullaby, and Rock-a-Bye Baby. Each melody lasts 1-2 minutes, creating a peaceful atmosphere to calm and stabilize your baby’s sleep. Let’s try putting on the headphones and listen to the melodies of a few songs from the playlist. 
The video showcases the product in use.The video guides you through product setup.The video compares multiple products.The video shows the product being unpacked.
Tinitigies Piano Lullabies
Preset to Lowest Volume for Baby's Comfort 
The music box is preset to the lowest volume level by default to avoid startling your baby when it starts. 
Easy to adjust the volume by holding the button (+) (-) 
Will this crib mobile fit a bassinet? 
This mobile is designed for cribs, not bassinets. Many returns happen because buyers expect it to fit a bassinet, but most bassinet rails are not compatible. Please check the mounting dimensions in our listing images carefully before ordering. 
Why can’t I hear the music when I turn it on? 
The music starts at the lowest volume by design to avoid startling your baby. If you hear little or no sound, simply turn up the volume and make sure the music box is not set to rotation-only mode. 
What modes does the digital music box have? 
It has 3 modes: rotation only, music only, or music + rotation. It also features a 30-minute auto shut-off for bedtime. Requires 2 AA batteries (not included). 
What if the music mechanism stops working within the first year? 
We carefully inspect every music mechanism before shipping. If the mechanism stops working under normal use within 1 year, we will replace it one-for-one at no charge.

productPageReviews.reviewTitle: Exactly as Advertised and we Love it
productPageReviews.reviewDescription: The mobile is exactly as advertised. Those complaining about "it doesn't fit my 2 inch crib!"....well duh. It says in the description that it fits max 1.3...something. I forgot the hundredth place decimal number. Anyway, now that I am done calling out the folks who take stars for their own stupidity, onto the product.It is a super sturdy design. I have no anxiety of looking to the camera and seeing it fallen onto my daughter. The volume is very good but it is static. There are no controls to change it at all. I find the volume to be good as it is but it is quiet, so be aware of that when you purchase. The colors catch my 3 month's attention very well, and the rotation is slow enough not to wake her up. The light display doesn't really seem to attract her, as I don't think she can see that far well, yet, but my partner and I enjoy it while we are in bed haha. All in all, I think it is pretty good value for the price (taking into consideration how expensive EVERYTHING is nowadays).

productPageReviews.reviewTitle: My baby loves it! Halo swivel compatibleMy baby loves it! Halo swivel compatible
productPageReviews.reviewDescription: My little one is absolutely mesmerized by this mobile! I love the different features on it. I wish the sound did have a volume control but it’s okay that it doesn’t- if anything it’s too quiet. I also like that it has different types of sounds to choose from. And the light display is very cute as well. Assembly was a breeze and I think it is well worth the price point.I originally found this mobile after searching ones that are compatible with the halo swivel bassinet. I have seen mixed reviews on here about how well it works with the bassinet. You cannot attach it directly to the bassinet without having some sort of grip there, the fabric and metal are too smooth. I used contact grip (like the kind used to line drawers) just to keep it from being so slick and it works beautifully. In the picture I have it on the fabric but you could also use the contact grip on the metal if you unzip the liner a little. Also the mobile is large enough to where you have it attached to the side of the bassinet if it did fall forward by any chance, it will catch on the other side of the bassinet and not land on your little one.

productPageReviews.reviewDescription: We're really enjoying this mobile. I love that it can be attached to any bassinet - ours is fabric - which I haven't found many to do. The music has a sset volume - you can't raise or lower it so that's a bit annoying (if you want to turn it on bec the baby's up but go back to sleep in the same room...ain't gonna happen). I like that you can turn the lights feature off if you don't want to waste battery while using it in a fully lit room. the lights really only show up when the room is very dark, so we don't end up using it much. It's a toy - the baby uses it in the daytime and light! Otherwise it's cute, looks sturdy enough, and the baby's enjoying!That said, the non-clipable ones we've had before (such as the Fisher Price jungle one) rotated in a more "interesting" way. No matter if I put it on a solid color or I’m half way through the songs, it will randomly reset and restart the loop. It also stopped turning off unless I switch it off. Which is annoying because it only takes batteries. If it was a plug in or rechargeable, I wouldn’t have any issues with it running constantlyUpdate.My replacement came in and I was so excited to use it because this mobile was great , but I recieved a used package that didn’t even work. I was so upset. I want to try to get another but I doubt that experience will be much better than these last two
productPageReviews.reviewedIn: Reviewed in the United States on June 5, 2024

productPageReviewsFromOtherCountries.reviewDescription: Love this product. My 6 week old was not sleeping at night and this mobile totally changed night time for us. She now sleeps great at night when soothed by the lights and music of this mobile. During the day she loves staring at the little cute animals circling around her.Would be great if it had a remote as it only plays for two time settings: 10mins and 15 mins. With a remote you could restart the mobile from bed.Other than that it’s a great product and so worth the cost! Great value! I would highly recommend it to anyone with a baby.

My baby love it. Downside: you can not low the volume, we taped it... and you can not move the mobile while is installed. Which is kind of inconvenient if the space is small. For the rest, love it. And it soothes my baby in less than 10 minutes she is hugging Morpheo in her dreams

This was the babies favorite mobile. Easy to use, setup, and the songs were great. I recommend singing along as babies love this most. At 5 months it looses its magic but that's all that is it's normal age range.Basic but good. If you want fancy then buy fancy but this does the job.

Order came in the mail quickly. Mobile is very cute, plays both music and calming sounds. The mobile stopped working, but the company was fantastic at reaching out and resolving the problem immediately. Would absolutely recommend them based on their great customer service and support!

Although this product is nice, it needs improvements. For example, there should be an option to turn the mobile on without the music and the height should be adjustable because my son can now just grab onto the toys and he pulls with all his might which I'm afraid will break this product. It is nice though, the display is bright and music is soothig, although no volume control

description: Galaxy A37 5G is a sleek and powerful entertainer that combines an elevated design, lasting performance, smart AI features, and triple-lens camera system. Its 6.7" Super AMOLED display¹ with immersive viewing and up to 1900 nits peak brightness makes videos, games and browsing look stunning. Capture every moment with the 50MP HDR camera, featuring brighter, sharper videos6 in low light and improved shot speed, while the studio-grade front camera ensures perfect selfies every time.Powered by the Samsung Exynos 1480 processor and a long-lasting battery with Super Fast Charging 2.0², Galaxy A37 5G keeps you going throughout your day. Plus, the enhanced durability of Gorilla Glass Victus+ and IP68 protection³ keeps your smartphone safe from dust and dirt no matter where the day may take you. Whether you're staying connected, capturing moments or browsing, A37 5G gives you premium performance at an affordable price. It's the smart choice you’ve been waiting for.¹Measured diagonally, the screen size is 6.7" in the full rectangle and 6.5" accounting for the rounded corners. Actual viewable area is less due to the rounded corners and the camera cutout.²45W Super Fast Charger sold separately. Super Fast Charging speed depends on battery level and other factors; use only Samsung-approved chargers and cables; do not use any worn or damaged chargers or cables; incompatible charger or cable can cause serious injuries or damage to your device.³IP68 rating for water and dust resistance. Water resistance based on laboratory test conditions for exposure to splashes of fresh water. Not advised for beach or pool use. productPageReviews.reviewDescription: So far great budget phone, only issue is Samsung's desire to not provide common features to the A series devices. Like wireless charging. They make you pay the "flagship" tax for that feature. But this is the economy of Samsung and most other budget friendly devices. Performance is good, battery life decent. The OS is running a more up to date OS vs some other budget devices. If your an Android user and don't want to spend the premium price, this is a good device, just know the features your missing.
